terminals.name: docfx-preview
terminals.description: Builds the ASP.NET docs with DocFX and serves the rendered site at http://localhost:8080 for local preview. Rebuild by restarting this terminal after editing Markdown.
terminals.command: cd aspnet && rm -rf _site obj && docfx build docfx.json -t default,/usr/local/share/docfx-preview-template && docfx serve _site --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
